reason: I already get slide-cited summaries, flashcards, and past papers for free by stacking NotebookLM, ChatGPT, Knowt, and campus Google Drive banks, so I don't see why I'd pay for a 7-day cram pass. On top of that, a 15-second timer and 4-second reading lock sounds stressful when my midterm is in 48 hours and I just want fast answers.
objection: Forcing a 15-second timer and 4-second reading lock slows me down when I need to look up a formula fast or work through Corporate Finance math, and free NotebookLM already links answers back to my slides.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the free starter deck nail tough Corporate Finance formula problems without forcing a 15-second timer and 4-second reading lock.
